index.title: Our solutions
index.intro: Five matched solutions for sleep, pain, stress and migraine. Which one fits you comes from the assessment.
index.guideTitle: The best way to your solution is the assessment
index.guideBody: This overview shows all solutions for reference. Your personal recommendation — and delivery — come from the assessment and the medical review.

pricesIndicative: Prices shown are indicative — your final price is confirmed after your medical review.

solution.afterApprovalNote: You can order once your medical review is approved.
solution.dispensedIntro: Depending on availability you receive one of these tested strains. All match the profile of {{name}}.
solution.coaIntro: Lab values for a representative batch. Every delivery carries its own batch certificate.
solution.notSureTitle: Not sure this is right for you?
solution.notSureBody: The assessment guides you to the right recommendation in a few minutes.
solution.formatValue: Available as oil or dried flower. Oil is the usual starting format; your prescribing doctor confirms what suits you.
solution.ingredientsValue: Full-spectrum medical cannabis — THC {{thc}}, with CBD and minor cannabinoids (CBG, CBN) plus the strain's natural terpenes. No additives.
solution.oilFormulationNote: The full-spectrum CBD oil this solution is based on — the format usually suggested to start with. The certificate below covers the dried-flower batch dispensed once a prescription is issued.
solution.amountHint: Recommended starting quantity based on common customer selection. Your prescribing doctor may adjust the exact amount to your needs.

night-now.blurb: A night-focused solution for users looking to support their evening routine.
night-now.why: For occasional or mild sleep problems and evening restlessness. A low THC range for a careful start.
night-now.usage: In the evening, about one to two hours before bed. The doctor sets the exact dosage.
night-now.suitability: Also suitable if you have little experience with medical cannabis.

calm-night.blurb: A stronger night-time option for users looking for deeper evening support.
calm-night.why: For stronger or frequent sleep problems when a light solution isn't enough. A calming, body-focused profile.
calm-night.usage: In the evening before bed. Start with a low dose, adjust during follow-up.
calm-night.suitability: For users with some experience. After medical review.

deep-ease.blurb: A body-focused solution for users looking for daily comfort support.
deep-ease.why: For chronic pain, muscle and joint discomfort through the day. A balanced daytime profile.
deep-ease.usage: Through the day per the medical dosing plan. Adjusted to your routine during follow-up.
deep-ease.suitability: For persistent discomfort that limits daily life. After medical review.

synergy-forte.blurb: A balanced solution for users looking for daily calm, balance and routine support.
synergy-forte.why: For mild to moderate tension, restlessness and tension headaches. A balanced profile you can use during the day.
synergy-forte.usage: During the day as needed within the medical dosing plan.
synergy-forte.suitability: As a first step for stress and migraine concerns. After medical review.

synergy-ultra.blurb: A stronger balanced solution for users looking for advanced daily support.
synergy-ultra.why: For stronger tension, anxiety or pain, and for experienced users. A higher THC range.
synergy-ultra.usage: Per the medical dosing plan. Start low, increase slowly.
synergy-ultra.suitability: For stronger symptoms or when a lighter solution isn't enough. After medical review.

coaSafetyValue: Tested for pesticides, heavy metals, aflatoxins and microbial contamination

dosage.a: The doctor sets the dosage and adjusts it to your routine during follow-up.

driving.q: Can I drive while using it?
driving.a: Products containing THC can affect your ability to drive. The medical consultation covers this.

delivery.a: Shipping is from the pharmacy — only after medical approval and a prescription is issued. Once dispatched, delivery across Austria typically takes a day: next-day if before 12:00, within two days if after.
